config.shift_drag_transfer.title: Shift Drag Transfer
config.shift_drag_transfer.category.gene: Master controls for Shift Drag Transfer.
config.shift_drag_transfer.category.drag: Configure quick-moving stacks by dragging across slots.
config.shift_drag_transfer.category.scro: Configure moving precise item amounts with the scroll wheel.
config.shift_drag_transfer.category.dest: Choose which player slots are used and how destinations are selected.
config.shift_drag_transfer.enabled.toolt: Master switch for all drag and scroll transfer behavior.
Quick-move every occupied slot crossed during a configured mouse drag.
config.shift_drag_transfer.drag.modifier: Keyboard modifier that must be held when beginning and continuing a drag.
config.shift_drag_transfer.drag.button.t: Mouse button used for quick-move dragging. Left is the safest default.
config.shift_drag_transfer.drag.from_con: Allow dragged stacks to quick-move from the open container into the player inventory.
config.shift_drag_transfer.drag.from_pla: Allow dragged stacks to quick-move from the player inventory into the open container.
config.shift_drag_transfer.drag.start_em: Start a drag gesture over an empty slot, then move across occupied slots.
Permit a slot to quick-move again after the pointer leaves and returns during the same drag.
config.shift_drag_transfer.scroll.enable: Move a configurable number of items by scrolling over a stack.
config.shift_drag_transfer.scroll.modifi: Optional keyboard modifier required while scrolling.
config.shift_drag_transfer.scroll.direct: Standard uses down for container-to-player and up for player-to-container. Inverted swaps them.
config.shift_drag_transfer.scroll.to_pla: Allow scroll transfer from storage slots into the player inventory.
config.shift_drag_transfer.scroll.to_con: Allow scroll transfer from the player inventory into the open container.
config.shift_drag_transfer.scroll.amount: Number of individual items transferred for each accepted scroll step. Higher values send more inventory actions.
config.shift_drag_transfer.scroll.cooldo: Minimum delay between successful scroll transfers. Increase this for strict servers.
config.shift_drag_transfer.inventory.mai: Allow the 27 main inventory slots as scroll sources and destinations.
config.shift_drag_transfer.inventory.hot: Allow the nine hotbar slots as scroll sources and destinations.
config.shift_drag_transfer.destination.p: Choose whether compatible partial stacks or empty slots are preferred.
config.shift_drag_transfer.destination.o: Choose which end of the inventory or container is searched first.
